title: Explore enhancements to your spatial business app
description: Discover how the latest enhancements and APIs in visionOS 26 expand access and extend enterprise capabilities announced last year. Learn how these all-new features make it easy to build model training workflows, enhance video feeds, and enable you to align coordinate systems over a local network to develop collaborative experiences in your in-house app.
